split_policy.embargo: 400 ms removed on both sides of the 60 and 78 percent boundaries
split_policy.clock: 1 kHz row order; time_s is not used because USB chunks repeat timestamps

state_model.criterion: highest dev macro F1, then accuracy

jump_event_threshold.criterion: dev event F1, recall, precision, false triggers/min, latency; one-to-one match [-400,+150] ms

crouch_contract.full_flexion_statistic: sit_stand directed angle q95 relative to stand median
crouch_contract.semantic: SHIFT is held only after both hips reach at least 95 percent of their training maximum for two ticks; otherwise SHIFT is released
